text:
alex: Quick check — where are we on metering hooks for the new pricing tiers? need to lock schema and owner for ingestion so billing can map events.
maya: FYI billing has a dependency on event names + plan_id being stable. we can't change names after the rollout window. who's owning that mapping? @alex?
jeff: I can own the plan_id -> ratecard mapping. blocked on final plan ids from product. do we have the final matrix?
alex: attaching the current matrix (preview). we still need to decide how quota buckets map to legacy contracts. two contract edge cases: annual customers with usage caps, and trial credits that shouldn't be billed.
sasha: for quotas the quota-service needs a flag for "contract_exempt" or similar. current API only supports numeric caps. adding a boolean will be a minor schema bump but requires feature flag rollout.
rohana: ops note — if we change the event schema, ingestion pipeline will drop unknown fields for 48h. so we need a migration plan: write new events with both old and new fields for 2 weeks.
jeff: +1 on dual-writing. also need sample payloads for billing tests. maya can you provide validation rules we expect? e.g., plan_id enum, usage_unit, timestamp rounding.
maya: validation: plan_id (string, allowed set), usage_units (integer), usage_type (token|embedding|storage), amount (float), customer_contract_id (optional). trials have usage_type=trial_credit.
alex: timeline proposal: finalize matrix by Thu EOD, devs implement dual-write and new plan_id by next Tue, billing run smoke tests Wed, go/no-go Friday. thoughts?
sasha: that timeline works for eng-platform but we need a canary in prod step for quota-service. recommend limiting to 5% of traffic for first 48h.
rohana: canary ok, ops will stand by for throttles and rollback. add on-call rotation in the PR description.
jeff: pinging infra to prep a billing test project and sample customer rows. tagging @qa-bot to run the regression harness once sample data is in.
qa-bot: scheduled: billing-regression suite queued for when sample data lands. please post the sample payloads to #eng-tests.
alex: one more: contract language — legal wants us to keep previous SLA wording for existing customers. product will keep legacy plan_ids mapped to legacy SLA. include that in mapping doc.
maya: noted. i'll add a validation that legacy plan_ids set a "legacy_sla": true field for billing to respect crediting rules.
alex: thanks all. i'll update the matrix and create a PR with migration plan + checklist. tagging the list of action owners in the PR body. :thumbsup:
